name: Wendy
source:
Wendy is a young girl who has just been told she'll have to grow up. Conflicted about her feelings, she is surprised that very night by Petra Pan: a young girl who proclaims she shall never grow up. And Wendy won't either, if she goes to Neverland.

[From [url=https://krispycat.itch.io/wendy]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Wendy是个刚被告知必须长大的小女孩，对自己的感受十分矛盾。就在那天夜里，Petra Pan突然出现。这个小女孩宣称，自己永远不会长大。只要Wendy前往梦幻岛，她也可以永远不长大。

[摘自[url=https://krispycat.itch.io/wendy]itch.io[/url]]
